content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the HBCH Sangrur Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: HBCH Sangrur Technician Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 1 vacancy is available - 1 for Technician (Radio Diagnosis).

content_sections.heading: HBCH Sangrur Technician Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: B.Sc. in Radiological Imaging Technology from a recognized University. OR B.Sc. in any subject/B. Pharmacy with a minimum two years Diploma in Medical Imaging Technology from the State Board of Technical Education or any equivalent Diploma from a recognized Board/University, with a minimum of 01-year Internship/experience from a large hospital with experience in CT and MRI.

content_sections.heading: HBCH Sangrur Technician Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 30 years. Relaxation for upper age to SC/ST/OBC as per Government of India instructions. Deserving and bright candidates may be given age relaxation. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

HBCH Sangrur Technician Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Technician (Radio Diagnosis) post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Technician (Radio Diagnosis) post at HBCH Sangrur is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Technician (Radio Diagnosis) position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. in Radiological Imaging Technology or a B.Sc. in any subject/B. Pharmacy with a minimum two years Diploma in Medical Imaging Technology and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Technician (Radio Diagnosis) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Technician (Radio Diagnosis) post is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Technician (Radio Diagnosis) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test (MCQ) followed by a Skill Test.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You need to carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital Sangrur, Punjab.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the position of Technician (Radio Diagnosis) is on a contractual basis.
